orders.title: Processing orders
orders.emptyBody: Plan one to take animals to the processing room.
orders.error: Processing orders could not be loaded
orders.denied: You do not have access to processing orders

newOrder.title: New processing order
newOrder.hint: Planning an order moves no stock. The animals are consumed, and the meat becomes lots, only when the order is completed.
newOrder.noLocations: There are no locations to choose from
newOrder.noLocationsBody: A processing order needs a processing location and an output location.
newOrder.locationsDenied: You cannot see the locations this needs
newOrder.locationHint: Where the animals are slaughtered. Changing it clears the animals chosen.
newOrder.outputLocationHint: Where the meat is kept, usually the cold room.
newOrder.weightHint: Three decimal places, from the scale where there is one.

order.title: Processing order {{name}}
order.notFound: There is no processing order at this address
order.error: This processing order could not be loaded
order.denied: You do not have access to this processing order

notice.started: Started. Nothing has moved yet: the animals are consumed when the order is completed.
notice.completed: Completed. The animals are consumed and the outputs are in their lots.
notice.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing had moved, so no stock or cost changed.
notice.costAdded: Cost added. It reaches the ledger when the order is completed.

actions.title: What happens next
actions.plannedHint: Start the order when the animals are in the processing room. Starting moves no stock.
actions.inProgressHint: Record what each animal yielded, then complete the order. Until it is completed it can still be cancelled with no stock or cost effect.

start.title: Start processing?
start.body: Each animal is checked again: one sold, moved or put under a hold since it was planned is refused. Starting moves no stock.

complete.title: Complete the order?
complete.body: This consumes the animals at their whole cost, turns each saleable output into a lot in the output location, and sends the direct costs to the ledger.
complete.consequence: A completed order cannot be changed or cancelled.
complete.allocation: The total cost and each output's share of it are worked out by the API when the order completes, by the sales value of each output. Waste takes no cost.

cancel.title: Cancel this processing order?
cancel.body: Nothing has moved before completion, so cancelling has no stock or cost effect. The reason is kept with the order.

addCost.title: Add a direct cost
addCost.descriptionHint: For example: slaughter and dressing, two hands.
addCost.confirmBody: It becomes part of the order's total cost, shared across the outputs when the order completes.

inputs.title: Animals in
inputs.costHint: Until the order completes, each cost is what the animal would carry now.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.noneUntilStarted: Outputs are recorded once the order is started.
outputs.editHint: Weigh each output and save the whole set. Saving again replaces what was saved before.
outputs.packsInvalid: Enter a whole number of packs
outputs.wasteHint: Waste has no packs and no use-by date, and takes no cost.

packs.title: Packs
packs.emptyBody: Cut packs from a saleable output to label them.
packs.denied: You do not have access to packs

labels.title: Labels
labels.cannot: This label's code, {{code}}, cannot be drawn as a barcode

pickers.animalsError: The animals could not be loaded
pickers.animalHint: Animals standing at the processing location. Type part of a tag to narrow the list.
pickers.onHold: under a hold, cannot be processed

standards.title: Yield standards
standards.description: The weight of each output expected from an animal's live weight, and how far a completed order may stray before it is flagged.
standards.emptyBody: Add one so completed orders are judged against it.
standards.error: Yield standards could not be loaded
standards.denied: You do not have access to yield standards
standards.newBody: One standard for each pair of input and output products.
standards.inputProductHint: The live animal, for example Goat.
standards.expectedHint: Output weight as a percentage of live weight, up to four decimal places.
standards.toleranceHint: How far the yield may stray before the order is flagged.
standards.percentInvalid: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, up to four decimal places
standards.notCreated: The yield standard was not added
standards.notSaved: The yield standard was not saved
standards.editBody: Orders already completed keep the yield they were judged with.
